#set document(title: "Uday Pratap Singh Parihar")
#set page(paper: "us-legal", margin: (left: 0.65in, right: 0.65in, top: 0.55in, bottom: 0.55in))
#set text(font: ("Liberation Sans", "Arial", "Helvetica Neue", "Helvetica", "Arimo"), size: 10pt, fill: rgb("#1A1F2B"))
#set par(leading: 0.55em, spacing: 0.55em, justify: false)

#let accent = rgb("#1D4ED8")
#let icon-color = accent
#let subtext = rgb("#374151")

#set list(indent: 0.15in, body-indent: 0.5em, marker: text(size: 0.72em)[#sym.bullet], spacing: 0.55em)

// Section header: vertically centered title underlined by a single blue rule.
#let sectionhead(title) = {
  v(12pt, weak: true)
  text(font: ("Liberation Sans", "Arial", "Helvetica Neue", "Helvetica", "Arimo"), fill: accent, weight: "bold", size: 12.5pt)[#upper(title)]
  v(4pt, weak: true)
  line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#1D4ED8"))
  v(8pt, weak: true)
}

// Entry helper with vertical centering, matching jake's robust spacing.
#let entry(
  title-co,
  date,
  location: none,
  description: none,
  bullets: none,
) = block(
  above: 10pt,
  below: 0pt,
  width: 100%,
)[
  #grid(columns: (1fr, auto), align: (left, right), [#strong[#title-co]], [#date])
  #if location != none [
    #v(2pt)
    #text(size: 0.9em, fill: subtext)[#location]
  ]
  #if description != none [
    #v(3pt)
    #description
  ]
  #if bullets != none [
    #v(3pt)
    #bullets
  ]
]

#let skillblock(body) = block(above: 10pt, below: 0pt)[
  #body
]

#text(font: ("Liberation Sans", "Arial", "Helvetica Neue", "Helvetica", "Arimo"), size: 24pt, weight: "bold", fill: accent)[Uday Pratap Singh Parihar]

#v(2pt)
#text(size: 10pt * 1.6, weight: "bold")[Full Stack Web Developer · React / Next.js / React Native · Node.js / PostgreSQL]

#v(2pt)
#text(size: 0.9em)[#box(baseline: 20%, height: 0.9em, image(bytes(read("/packages/renderer/icons/location.svg").replace("<svg ", "<svg fill=\"" + icon-color.to-hex() + "\" ")), format: "svg")) Indore, India (open to relocating) | #box(baseline: 20%, height: 0.9em, image(bytes(read("/packages/renderer/icons/phone.svg").replace("<svg ", "<svg fill=\"" + icon-color.to-hex() + "\" ")), format: "svg")) +91 88199 23334 | #box(baseline: 20%, height: 0.9em, image(bytes(read("/packages/renderer/icons/email.svg").replace("<svg ", "<svg fill=\"" + icon-color.to-hex() + "\" ")), format: "svg")) #link("mailto:work@udayps.com")[work\@udayps.com] | #box(baseline: 20%, height: 0.9em, image(bytes(read("/packages/renderer/icons/linkedin.svg").replace("<svg ", "<svg fill=\"" + icon-color.to-hex() + "\" ")), format: "svg")) #link("https://www.linkedin.com/in/uday-ps")[uday-ps] | #box(baseline: 20%, height: 0.9em, image(bytes(read("/packages/renderer/icons/github.svg").replace("<svg ", "<svg fill=\"" + icon-color.to-hex() + "\" ")), format: "svg")) #link("https://github.com/UdayPS-4o/")[UdayPS-4o] | #box(baseline: 20%, height: 0.9em, image(bytes(read("/packages/renderer/icons/website.svg").replace("<svg ", "<svg fill=\"" + icon-color.to-hex() + "\" ")), format: "svg")) #link("https://portfolio.udayps.com/")[portfolio.udayps.com]]

#sectionhead[Profile]
Full stack developer with 3+ years shipping commercial web and mobile applications end to end. Currently #strong[founding engineer at Akin], where I built and shipped a React Native consumer app to the #strong[App Store and Play Store] on an Express/PostgreSQL backend. Previously two years as founding engineer on a live B2B logistics platform, owning architecture, backend, dashboards and integrations. Comfortable with real-time services, cloud deployment, LLM-powered features, and reverse-engineering undocumented APIs when no SDK exists.

#v(12pt, weak: true)

#sectionhead[Work Experience]
#entry([Founding Engineer, Akin], [Dec 2025 --- Present], location: [Remote], bullets: [
- Built and shipped a #strong[React Native (Expo)] community app to the #strong[App Store and Play Store], now at #strong[6,000+ registrations] with invite-only events running across #strong[Delhi, Mumbai, New York and Dubai].
- Shipped event discovery and booking, digital tickets, location-based member discovery with maps, push notifications and #strong[4 sign-in methods] (email/SMS OTP, Apple, Google); cleared #strong[full Apple and Google store review] with EAS builds and #strong[over-the-air updates].
- Owned the #strong[Express + PostgreSQL] backend across an #strong[18-table] schema (Drizzle ORM) plus admin dashboards, deployed as #strong[Dockerized] services behind Traefik with automated migrations.
])
#entry([Software Engineer Intern, Tradyon], [May 2025 --- Jul 2025], location: [Bengaluru, India], bullets: [
- Shipped production features and fixes across #strong[web and mobile] (Next.js + React Native), improving chatbot UX and reliability.
- Built #strong[agentic LLM workflows] in Dify orchestrating model calls with #strong[BigQuery]-backed trade-data retrieval.
- Delivered #strong[rich responses] (text plus charts and graphs) by wiring workflows into the app's data and services layer.
])
#entry([Founding Engineer, Delivo], [Jan 2023 --- Feb 2025], location: [Mumbai, India], bullets: [
- Owned the #strong[full stack] as first engineer on a platform serving #strong[9,000+ users] and #strong[100k+ shipments]: architecture, REST backend and database design, auth and role-based access, and external integrations.
- Shipped #strong[client and warehouse dashboards] turning live shipment data into actionable views for non-technical operations staff.
- Integrated #strong[partner and carrier systems] under international shipping compliance; handled deployment, monitoring and production support.
])

#v(12pt, weak: true)

#sectionhead[Freelance Projects]
#entry([EHR Integration Layer — eClinicalWorks], [Aug 2025], bullets: [
- Reverse-engineered #strong[encrypted request payloads] and built a custom API wrapper from traffic analysis, enabling #strong[UI-free] patient creation and appointment scheduling where #strong[no public API existed].
])
#entry([High-Throughput E-commerce Automation — Myntra, Flipkart], [Dec 2023], bullets: [
- Built restock/price monitors and a request-driven bulk checkout engine at #strong[under 2 s per order and 500+ concurrency], with a centralized dashboard on #strong[GCP Cloud Run] and automated card payments with #strong[3DS/OTP] handling.
])
#entry([Field Operations Platform — FMCG distribution], [], bullets: [
- ERP-style web app (invoicing, stock transfers, reporting) plus an #strong[Android/iOS companion app] with push notifications and geolocation.
- #strong[Real-time] updates over Socket.IO, WhatsApp webhook and web-push messaging, Excel/PDF pipelines, and a custom ORM for a #strong[legacy DBF database].
])

#v(12pt, weak: true)

#sectionhead[Skills]
#skillblock[
#strong[Frontend:] TypeScript, React, Next.js, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, React Native (Expo), Flutter \
#strong[Backend:] Node.js, Express.js, NestJS, Python, PHP, REST APIs, WebSockets, JWT / OAuth \
#strong[Databases:] PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, BigQuery, Firebase \
#strong[Cloud & DevOps:] GCP (Cloud Run), AWS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Linux \
#strong[AI & Integrations:] LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), Dify agentic workflows, Payments (3DS/OTP), Push & messaging, API/Android reverse engineering (Burp, Frida)
]

#v(12pt, weak: true)
